messages:
Aria: quick heads-up 1: did a pass on mobile responsive behaviour. at 360px the sidebar leaves a gap and table cells get squished. screenshots in thread.
Sam: saw them. header labels disappear when you scroll because the header isn't sticky once the nav is visible.
Noah: current CSS switches to overlay under 480px but the runtime uses a different breakpoint (360) for mobile math. probable mismatch.
Lina: accessibility - when overlay opens, focus moves to the first link but there's no announced close button on TalkBack. also row action icons are too close together.
Aria: UX proposal: at <=360px enable "compact-mode" which auto-collapses low-priority columns into a per-row overflow. keep primary columns: name/status/updated/actions.
Sam: agree. add a small indicator like "+2" on the row to show hidden fields exist. also keep a horizontal scroll fallback if JS is disabled.
Noah: implementation plan: add .compact-columns class, render overflow content in a panel opened from kebab menu. server-side can tag column priorities for large tables.
Lina: ARIA notes: kebab should have aria-label="More details for {row name}" and when opened trap focus. restore focus to the kebab on close.
Sam: CSS snippet to try:
```
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.table thead { position: sticky; top: 56px; z-index: 40; background: var(--bg); }
.row .hit { padding: 8px; margin: -8px; }
```
Aria: copy tweak request: rename small-screen "Filters" to "Refine" to save space. check L10n for expansion.
Noah: question: slide-from-left vs bottom-sheet for nav. my lean: left slide for global nav, bottom-sheet for contextual drawers.
Sam: same. left slide preserves section context. ensure backdrop click/escape closes and sets inert on main content.
Lina: also test 200% zoom, RTL, and VoiceOver open/close. sticky header sometimes overlaps with the nav when zoomed.
QA-bot: added checklist: voiceover flow, talkback, 200% zoom, i18n, touch-targets >=44px, keyboard nav.
Aria: action items: Noah/Sam to fix overlay breakpoint mismatch and implement compact collapse; Lina to run a11y tests when PR is up; Sam to update mocks and run L10n check. deadline Tue noon.
Noah: starting a small PR now, will link.
design-bot: reminder: mobile UX review Tue 2pm in #design. :spiral_calendar:
